intro.title: Accessibility (a11y) Fundamentals
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple, accessible Angular component for a user profile card. You'll learn the core concepts of web accessibility (a11y), focusing on semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, and ARIA attributes. The main technologies involved are Angular templates, TypeScript, and built-in HTML accessibility features. By the end, you'll understand how to make your Angular applications usable for everyone, including people using assistive technologies.
intro.usecase: Accessibility fundamentals are essential for building inclusive web applications used by millions, such as public service portals, banking dashboards, and e-commerce sites. Developers implement a11y features like semantic HTML, ARIA attributes, and keyboard navigation in common UI components—forms for user registration, data tables in admin panels, interactive filters for product searches, and modal dialogs for confirmations. Mastering these practices ensures all users, including those relying on screen readers or keyboard-only input, can effectively interact with your application, meeting legal standards and expanding your product's reach.
